title: Vinotherapy Wine Soak and 50 min Facial
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This experience combines the antioxidant-rich benefits of vinotherapy with a results-driven Caudalie Vinosource Hydra Facial. Guests begin with a wine-infused soak to relax the body and prep the skin, followed by a targeted facial designed to deeply hydrate, soothe, and restore radiance—delivering both indulgent relaxation and visible, glowing results. As the only wine spa in the USA, this is a truly one-of-a-kind experience you won’t find anywhere else.
